MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

2. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 1000 m²

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 43
   C. 49
   D. 41

4. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 121
   C. 11
   D. 122

5. Solve for x: x + 9 = 21. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 9
   C. 13
   D. 12

6. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 8
   C. 17
   D. 0

7. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 11
   D. 24

8. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 50
   C. 7
   D. 49

9. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 42
   D. 36

10. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 2

11. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 81

12. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 13
   C. 41
   D. 3

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — 10

2. B — 10 000 m²

3. D — 41
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 9² + 40²
3. c² = 81 + 1600
4. c² = 1681
5. c = 41
Final Answer: 41 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse

4. B — 121
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 11² = 11 × 11
3. 11² = 121
Final Answer: 121
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

5. D — 12
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: x = RHS − constant
2. Substitute values: x = 21 − 9
3. x = 12
Final Answer: x = 12
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

Working:

2. Substitute values: Product = 4 × 4
3. Product = 16
Final Answer: 16
